nba.title: Simulator upgrade, October 2026
nba.summary: About thirty factors were tested one at a time on the 2024-25 season, and only those that made the numbers more accurate were kept. The combination was then checked on 2025-26, a season none of the choices were made on. The biggest gain came from who plays and for how long.

kept.name: Recent minutes
kept.what: planned minutes lean 75% toward the last few games (half-life two games), catching role changes, benchings and trades

kept.name: Recent rates
kept.what: shooting, passing and rebounding rates lean a quarter of the way toward the last ten games

kept.name: Shot zones
kept.what: from play-by-play: each shooter's rim share against the defense's rim protection, blocks by shot distance, how often each shooter's makes are assisted

kept.name: Betting total and spread
kept.what: each game's pace and margin are moved to ESPN's line before the real run

kept.name: Questionable players
kept.what: play in their share of the simulated games (probable 95%, day-to-day 75%, questionable 60%) and are priced for the games they play

kept.name: Re-run before tip-off
kept.what: games whose injury news changes after the morning are played again before tip-off, and their picks replaced

untested: play types and player tracking (stats.nba.com blocks cloud servers)

cfb.title: Simulator upgrade, October 2026
cfb.season: The 2026 season to date, held out
cfb.summary: Every factor was tested one at a time on the 2025 season, and only those that made the numbers more accurate were kept. The combination was then checked on 2026 to date, which none of the choices were made on.

kept.name: Recent usage
kept.what: targets and carries lean 75% toward each player's last four appearances (half-life two games)

kept.name: Blowouts
kept.what: from the fourth quarter, a side up or down 28+ sits its starting quarterback, top two backs and top three receivers

kept.name: Betting total and spread
kept.what: each team's offense is scaled so the game matches ESPN's line before the real run

untested: weather (ESPN keeps none for college games)
depth charts and injury reports (not archived)
